description: Asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and/or Gemini the user's buyer questions several times each (five runs per question on the free plan) and returns how often the brand is named, its average position, the range around the rate, the other brands named instead and the domains the answers cite, plus a report link. Takes 30 to 90 seconds. Counts against the free daily allowance. Pass one to five plain buying questions as a shopper would type them.

brand.description: Brand name as people write it, for example Acme Running

domain.description: Optional website, for example acmerunning.com, used to spot mentions by URL

models.description: Which assistants to ask; defaults to chatgpt

prompts.description: One to five buyer questions, for example "Best running shoes for flat feet under $150?"

name: check_ai_visibility
title: Check how often AI assistants name a brand
